profile.headline: Senior Back End Developer at POLYWOOD
profile.summary: Programmer with over 10+ years of professional experience in web application programming and technical support.  I am highly familiar with a wide variety of computer languages such as PHP, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, JSON, HTML, CSS, XML, SASS, Gulp, and APIs through REST and SOAP.  I also have experience in creating, debugging and deploying custom Magento modules as well as third party extensions.

positions.title: Lead Magento Developer
positions.description:
• Provide mentorship and technical leadership to other developers on the team, aid in finding solutions, pass on knowledge, and enforce standards.
• Directly manage other developers on the team.
• Lead and develop new, value driven projects, enhancing the design and functionality of our e-commerce website.
• Identify issues, strategize solutions, and communicate progress throughout the development lifecycle.
• Research, install, and configure third party Magento extensions.
• Manage project deployment processes.
• Work with different languages and frameworks such as : LAMP, Magento 1 and 2, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, HTML, CSS, XML, SASS, Gulp, APIs through REST and SOAP
• Work with different software packages such as: PhpStorm, BitBucket, JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins, Kibana, New Relic, Docker, CLI (SSH/Git), Postman, Sequel Pro, Warden, Docker

positions.title: Magento Developer
positions.description:
•	Conduct project specification gathering session with clients and design websites to address the request.
•	Program, test, and debug new/existing websites using PHP, jQuery, JavaScript,  and HTML within Magento.
•	Research and install plugins based on client requirements
•	Create and update database queries using SQL based on project specifications.
•	Create project documentations, test plans, flow charts, and instructions for new/existing websites.

positions.title: Analyst Programmer I
positions.description:
•Web Development
----Led project specification gathering session with project requester and design web applications to address the request.
----Created, tested, and debugged new/existing web applications using ASP (Classic), PHP, JavaScript, AJAX, VBScript, HTML, and jQuery. 
----Created, tested, and debugged new/existing SQL queries using joins, grouping, subqueries, etc. based on project specifications
----Created an API integration that allowed our custom web application to interact with third party websites
---------Reduced paper health applications by 95% by integrating our website to communicate with CampDoc’s website.  This integration replaced the 5000+ paper health applications we received with the ability to complete the health profile online.
----Created project documentations, test plans, flow charts, and instructions for new/existing web applications.
----Configured web server using windows authentication, ip restriction, user groups, etc.

•Conducted training for new and current staff members on different custom web applications and computer software.

•Managed technical support inquiries from external customers and internal staff members.

•Managed Hardware
----Configured and deployed to new/current staff members
----Purchased equipment and managed inventory
----Coordinated updates with the Office of Information Technology for staff members

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
•Created, tested, and debugged websites using ASP(Classic), JavaScript, AJAX, VBScript, and HTML 

•Utilized eCommerce Software and Content Management System to program websites to meet the clients’ needs.

•Created, maintained, and updated databases for clients on Microsoft Access and MySQL.

•Utilized SmarterMail software to create new user email accounts, trouble-shoot email issues, and re-set email passwords

•Set-up DNS records and website root folders on Server 2008 using IIS 7 and Server 2003 using IIS 6

•Assisted clients in resolving technical issues with websites 

•Provided training to clients on the accurate and most successful way to use different software tools

•Utilized the Basecamp software for communication with remote project managers

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
•Programmed, tested, and debugged websites using ASP (Classic), JavaScript, and HTML.

•Planned, created, maintained, and updated databases for clients through the use of Microsoft Access and MySQL.

•Installed, configured, and troubleshoot databases on remote Servers as well as on computers on the Local Area Network.

•Worked with clients to resolve all issues with websites.

•Created website folders on Windows Server 2008.

•Worked cohesively with the SEO team, and the Web Design team to insure that projects are completed within budget.

•Attended weekly networking meetings with Business Networking International to generate web development business leads.

•Utilized different internet marketing strategies such as SEO, PPC, and WYSIWG.

•Created user manuals for new employees as well as current employees to assist them in learning new software.

•Trained new hires and current employees on the use of a variety of different computer software.

•Provided training to clients remotely and in-person on the accurate and most successful way to use the different software tools.

•Used Microsoft Exchange to create new user email accounts, troubleshoot email issues, and reset email passwords.

•Installed printers, scanners, fax machines, and other peripherals.

•Configured wireless network for access from laptops, PCs, printers, and other peripherals.

positions.title: Admissions Advisor
positions.description:
•Provided accurate status reports in MS Office Programs relating to individual recruitment effectiveness

•Created tracking logs to assist in determining time and money spent on recruiting students.

•Contact potential students through phone or MS Outlook to initiate the admissions process

•Achieve performance goals set by the Director of Admissions

•To make certain prospective students have realistic expectations regarding their course of study by adhering strictly to established standards for Admissions

•Assisted my department in troubleshooting with regards to hardware and software

•Configured printers 

•Work with Windows XP, 2000,and Vista

•Work with MS Office Suite 2000,2003, and 2007
